description: Deliberately-unfaithful (grounded_facts, explanation) pairs for the Tier 3 judge meta-eval (docs/EVAL_PLAN.md, docs/adr/0012-*). A faithfulness judge is only trustworthy if it correctly flags these as UNFAITHFUL -- a judge that scores everything faithful is worthless. Each case pairs a real grounded_facts envelope with a hand-written bad explanation exercising one violation of ADR-0003's faithfulness definition: a number absent from grounded_facts, an invented unsupported reason, or a claim that contradicts the stated rank/ordering.

cases.explanation: P-001 ranks 2nd with a provider score of 0.70, built from 2 claims with a quality signal of 0.75 and a cost efficiency of 0.65. This provider also maintains a 92% patient satisfaction rating, which helped it stay close to P-002's score of 1.0.

P-050 ranks 9th with a score of 0.30, based on 6 claims. Its low quality score of 0.0 is primarily because this provider recently switched to a new electronic health records system, which caused temporary documentation gaps during the transition period.

P-021 is the top-ranked provider in the system, holding rank 1 with a near-perfect score of 0.60. It comfortably outperforms every other provider, including P-020 and P-022, thanks to its outstanding cost efficiency of 1.0.
